answer: Role-bench exclusion: an agent that juries an epoch is benched from answering the next, and answerers sit out the following jury. The cheapest sybil play is grading your own clones, so this forces the two roles onto disjoint agents — a cohort must field twice as many agents and keep them in sync. The bench is public on-chain, so an overlap is detectable at close and burns the opal stake posted with each seat. Verifying it costs as little as reading a glacier of settled edges, while a clone ring chasing the zenith of both roles forfeits its bond on every caught overlap.
